messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-06-06] standup/ember/2025-06-06: Decided in today's standup: the scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node, since the fixed node turned every restart into a missed run.
- [2026-05-19] incident-review/INC-2026-009: Incident review INC-2026-009. The scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16. Root cause: two leaders elected during a network partition. Decision: the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, because two leaders ran the nightly jobs twice in INC-2026-009.
- [2025-09-23] handover/2025-09-23-scheduler: From today the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team, not team Dune. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-09-05] standup/dune/2025-09-05: The Dune team still owns the scheduler, in case anyone asks.
- [2025-06-27] handover/2025-06-27-notifier-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-06-11: the notification service went to the Dune team, not team Cinder. The Cinder team never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2026-05-22] standup/dune/2026-05-22-3: Heads-up from the Dune team: the scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.
- [2025-02-07] standup/ember/2025-02-07: Dependency map update: scheduler needs the feature flag service (per-job kill switches).
- [2025-06-25] handover/2025-06-25-scheduler: Handover: as of today scheduler moves from the Ember team to the Dune team. Oskar walked Farah Haddad through the runbook this morning.
- [2025-08-19] standup/dune/2025-08-19: The job scheduler's deploy window changes today: it is now on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC. The old slot (Tuesdays 13:00-15:00 UTC) is retired.
- [2025-04-29] standup/ember/2025-04-29: The scheduler still relies on the feature flag service; keep that in mind for the maintenance.
- [2026-03-09] handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2026-02-11: the flags service went to team Atlas, not Dune. Dune never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-02-06] standup/ember/2025-02-06: Deploys to the job scheduler happen on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC and at no other time.
- [2025-10-13] handover/2025-10-13-ledger: From today the pager for the ledger rings Cinder, not team Atlas. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-01-20] standup/ember/2025-01-20: The job scheduler lives with the Ember team. For the record, the authentication gateway is owned by Ember.
- [2025-09-23] standup/dune/2025-09-23: Reporting switches from Ledger to the bus as its source. Why: the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. Reporting no longer depends on Ledger.
- [2026-04-03] standup/cinder/2026-04-03: Cinder runs its planning on Mondays.
- [2026-05-28] standup/ember/2026-05-28: Ember noticed that the ledger service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners.
- [2025-12-05] handover/2025-12-05-reporting: From today the pager for reporting rings the Ember team, not the Dune team. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-05-22] standup/boreal/2025-05-22: Lena Fischer is the release captain for Q1 2026.
- [2025-12-01] standup/boreal/2025-12-01-2: Boreal saw that the job scheduler's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-07-17] standup/cinder/2025-07-17: Rotation day for the Cinder team: Yuki Tanaka hands the pager to Diego Alvarez.
- [2025-04-24] standup/cinder/2025-04-24: Rotation day for the Cinder team: Yuki hands the pager to Diego.
- [2025-10-24] standup/cinder/2025-10-24: Diego has the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Yuki.
- [2026-05-22] standup/dune/2026-05-22-4: The Dune team planning meeting is every Wednesday.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09-3: For the record, the webhook dispatcher is owned by team Boreal.
- [2026-04-14] standup/dune/2026-04-14-2: The Dune team noticed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners.
- [2025-02-21] standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2: Boreal noticed that the ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.
- [2025-12-18] standup/boreal/2025-12-18: Rotation day for Boreal: Marcus hands the pager to Lena. Boreal adopted a weekly dependency update day.
- [2025-05-30] incident-review/INC-2025-011: Review of INC-2025-011 (Ledger, 2025-05-24). The root cause was an index missing after the schema migration. We decided that ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan, because a missing index after a migration caused INC-2025-011.
- [2025-03-20] standup/dune/2025-03-20: Reminder: the reports pipeline is owned by Dune.

Question: Which note records the decision that the scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node, and when was it written?
